invariants.rationale: If the text area has keyboard focus, the method will always return true. If not, it delegates to the superclass's keyDown.
If the text area has keyboard focus, the result will always be true.
If keycode is neither DOWN nor UP, moveOffset is set to -1.
If the method returns false, it must be because the text area does not have keyboard focus.
If the method returns false, it must be because the superclass also would have returned false.
